svg.title: (b) Reconfigurable processing element — register-transfer datapath
svg.text: W = DATA_W; P = ACC_W. A single signed multiplier and adder are shared by OS, WS, and IS.
Register triangles denote clk. clear resets accumulators and forwarding/partial-sum registers; resident A/B registers hold.
use_product = step & mac_valid & legal_mode & (!ZERO_GATE | (lhs ≠ 0 & rhs ≠ 0)); a zero product still forwards the addend.
